shortDescription: SSB Constable to Head Constable (Medical Cadre) recruitment 2026 notification is available. PET/PST exam date and admit card release date are not officially announced yet.
content:
Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) published the official recruitment notice for Constable to Head Constable (Medical Cadre) on 21 March 2026.

The official SSB recruitment portal currently does not show a separate PET/PST exam-date notice or admit-card release notice for this Medical Cadre recruitment. Therefore, the PET/PST date should not be marked as announced until SSB publishes an official notice.

Candidates should regularly check the official SSB recruitment portal for the PET/PST schedule and admit card/call letter.
